1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.

2. This bail application has been filed on behalf of the petitioner, namely, Mithilesh Sah @ Mithilesh Kumar Gupta @ Mithlesh Sah with a prayer to release on bail in connection with POCSO Case No.
26/24 arising out of Dhurki P.S. Case No. 09 of 2024, registered under sections 452/376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of POCSO Act, pending before the Court of learned Special Judge,
POCSO, Garhwa.

entities.text: Mithilesh Sah @ Mithilesh Kumar Gupta @ Mithlesh Sah
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: 3. The FIR of this case was lodged by the victim herself with these allegations that on 16.01.2024 at 5.00 P.M., the accused Mithilesh Sah @ Mithilesh Kumar Gupta @ Mithlesh Sah came to her house where she was alone and he dropped her on the ground and forcibly established physical relation with her.

entities.text: Mithilesh Sah @ Mithilesh Kumar Gupta @ Mithlesh Sah
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: The statement of victim was also recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and the victim also corroborated the prosecution story.

Further, she stated that on raising alarm by her after the occurrence, her parents and the persons of the locality came there and this petitioner was also nabbed and ultimately, was handed over to the Police.
4.
As per her school certificate, the date of birth of the victim is shown 20th May, 2009.

1 the date of the occurrence, the victim was minor of about 15 years old.

sentences.text: For the DNA test, the blood sample of both the victim and the accused was taken and the report of the same is being awaited.

The statement of victim was also corroborated with the statement of her grandfather, namely,
Amindra Prajapati, her mother, namely, Kiran Devi and her aunt, namely, Lalita Devi.
5.
In view of the materials on record, the bail petition of the petitioner is rejected.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Vedanti/-
